name: Kajsa Lancaster
reason: Too thin: her own site quantum-otter.co.uk (The Quantum Otter, Canterbury, Kent; robots.txt allows us) is a single page whose only offering is in-person Quantum-Touch sessions (£50, £60 at home, first session £30), with no workshops, free resources or videos; its 'What can you use Quantum-Touch for?' list also leads with pain, injury, misalignment, insomnia, headaches and depression, which would be left out. Contact is a form only (email on her Quantum-Touch profile). For the owner: trained with Karina Grant (already listed).
